A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same SmartCLIP work. All 15 pages, including equations, figures, tables, supplementary proofs, and generation examples, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original SmartCLIP retrieval, classification, ablation, and image-generation results in Section 6, with additional generation examples in supplementary Section 9.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results in Section 6 and supplementary Section 9.

M1.justification: Sections 4–5 retain the same adaptive masking network, modular contrastive pairs, sparsity penalty, and combined training objective.

E1.justification: Coverage remains ShareGPT4V, Urban1k, COCO, Flickr30K, nine zero-shot classification datasets, and long-caption image generation. No datasets or task scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: CLIP, Direct Fine-tuning, and Long-CLIP in Tables 1–2; CLIP and LongCLIP in Table 3; and LongCLIP in Table 5.

E3.justification: Section 6.1 retains the same data splits, sample sizes, B/16 and L/14 configurations, token limit, training settings, and evaluation metrics.

E4.justification: The modular-alignment ablation, coefficient sweeps, caption-diversity experiments, ScoreCAM visualizations, and generation examples are unchanged, including supplementary examples.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The tables and plots retain the same uncertainty-reporting practices.

E6.justification: Results in Tables 1–5 and Figures 4–8 are unchanged. For example, B/16 SmartCLIP ShareGPT4V image-to-text R@1 remains 98.7 in Table 2, and its KID remains 1.02 in Table 5.

T1.justification: Definition 4.1, Condition 4.2, Theorem 4.3, and the three-step proof in supplementary Section 8 retain the same mathematical content.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about information preservation, concept disentanglement, identification guarantees, and SmartCLIP's empirical advantages.

C2.justification: Interpretations of modular alignment, caption diversity, and ImageNet performance are unchanged. Section 7 retains the same limitation concerning caption coverage and Condition 4.2(ii).

D1.justification: The mask-network implementation, learning rates, batch size, hardware and training-time disclosures, and code-access link are unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 59 references and positioning relative to CLIP variants and multi-view latent-variable identification research are retained.

P1.justification: v2 adds the Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence affiliation to Shaoan Xie and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Body wording and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–8, Tables 1–5, captions, placement, and appendix image grids are unchanged. Visual inspection establishes no figure, table, or layout revision.

improvement.justification: v2 updates author-affiliation and version metadata while retaining the same scientific arguments, experimental evidence, proofs, reproducibility information, and limitations. These administrative edits produce no meaningful overall quality difference.
